title: Great time. Learned so much about Picasso
text: Our tour guide was phenomenal. We did walking tour of Barcelona to all places that Picasso went to as person. Great seeing his home and school. I appreciated that we got to go to El Gats, the restaurant he went to with other artists of Modernist movement. I appreciated learning about the Picasso, the person. She also showed us columns from the Romans.
author: adamfT6145IX

title: Delightful tour on Picasso with Liliia!
text: We loved every minute of our tour with Liliia. She added a lot of additional not well known anecdotal information to our Picasso tour and also included more information about Barcelona and Guadi we had not received before. She was a delight!
author: PattyZ1979

title: Wonderful insights on Picasso and the surrounding Gothic Quarters
text: Sebastian was terrific! He had a great depth of knowledge and provided key insights on Picasso and his life, as well as the broader history and context of Spain. The tour also included the Gothic Quarters and entry to the Picasso Museum. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour, and highly recommend it. Seb was friendly, approachable and engaging. Many thanks!
author: Carrie_C

title: We were so fortunate to have Alan as our guide!!  He taught us so much about Picasso and the history and culture of BCN!
text: We were fortunate to have Alan as our guide!  He taught us so much about Picasso and the history and culture of Barcelona!  Having an expert lead us through the winding streets allowed us to really see the city!!
author: IORFA

title: Picasso tour
text: Together with our teenage daughters we did a tour with a Picasso theme. Sebastian did a great job making it very engaging and bringing history to life. He adapted it to our interests, mixing in other interesting history of Barcelona, its artists and Spain in general. Good mix between walking around and taking stops at different landmarks.
